Subject: Routing policy: hands-on session availability, prework, and fallback tiering

Hi Ravi / Anna,

Thanks again for working with us on the evaluation. To make the demo useful for your platform team, we want to run a focused hands-on session that covers:
- Prompt walkthrough and sample workload replay (30–45m)
- Model selection tradeoffs and quantization considerations (30m)
- Routing policy design: tiers, regional failover, and fallback rules (45m)
- Controlled load tests (30m) + validation checklist

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue Dec 7, 09:00–12:00 (split into 2 blocks)
- Wed Dec 8, 13:00–16:00

Prework I attached (redwood-routing-prework.pdf) — 10–15 minutes to skim. Please flag any data sensitivities or constraints (e.g., no external telemetry) so we can tailor the sandbox.

Marcus and Lauren from our team will run the session. Monica will coordinate the load tests.

Could you confirm which window works best and who from Acme should be present (platform lead + networking + app owner recommended)?

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.ai

Hi Rachel,

Thanks — both windows look reasonable. Quick notes from our side:
- Platform lead (me), infra (Anna), and app owner (Katherine) will attend.
- We prefer Dec 8 in the afternoon but need a shorter 3-hour block (13:30–16:30 PT) rather than 13:00 start.
- We have a maintenance window Dec 7 morning, so Dec 7 won't work.

Thanks Ravi — Dec 8 13:30–16:30 PT works for us.

Quick operational plan suggestion:
1) 13:30–14:15: Prompt review + replay (Marcus leads). We'll run a short replay using the anonymized trace subset you provide; if security prefers synthetic we can do that instead.
2) 14:15–15:00: Model selection & quantization tradeoffs (Lauren leads). We'll show 2 candidate model families and cost/latency profiles.
3) 15:00–15:45: Routing policy deep-dive (Rachel + Marcus): tiering, regional priorities, automated fallback rules, and Canary failover behavior.
4) 15:45–16:30: Run controlled load bursts and verify latency/SLOs (Monica runs load harness).

Pre-session asks (please upload before Dec 6):
- Small sample of anonymized traces or a description of the p95 request size
- List of critical regions/services that must remain low-latency
- Any strict data handling requirements

I'll send a calendar invite with the 3-hour block and attach the loadtest plan and fallback templates.

--

Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
